summary_zh: 本页标题为“欲擒故纵”，配图描绘了一位身穿铠甲、手持短剑的壮硕武将坐在席上，身后有持矛侍卫，前方摆放着酒食，场景似为古代军营或议事厅，暗示即将展开与该成语相关的故事情节。

page_text_ocr_zh:
西晋末年，羯族首领石勒占据襄国，又想攻取幽州。可是，幽州太守王浚手握重兵，石勒想打下来不容易。
刚好这一年，幽州遭遇了蝗灾和旱灾，石勒觉得这是天赐良机，就准备派使者到王浚那里，打探一下幽州的情况。
page_text_en:
At the end of the Western Jin dynasty, Shi Le, the leader of the Jie tribe, occupied Xiangguo and wanted to capture Youzhou. However, Wang Jun, the governor of Youzhou, commanded a large army, making it difficult for Shi Le to take the region.
Just that year, Youzhou suffered from locust plagues and drought. Shi Le saw this as a divine opportunity and decided to send an envoy to Wang Jun to investigate the situation in Youzhou.
summary_zh: 本页讲述了西晋末年，石勒欲攻取幽州，但因王浚兵强马壮而难以得手；恰逢幽州遭遇蝗灾和旱灾，石勒认为时机已到，准备派使者探查幽州情况。

page_text_ocr_zh:
石勒的谋士张宾说："王浚表面上是晋朝的臣子，实际却想自己当皇帝。将军您威振海内，王浚一定想招募您，帮他完成大业。不如您假意向他俯首称臣，取得他的信任。"
石勒高兴得连连击掌，笑着说："这个计策好！"于是，石勒给王浚写了一封信。
page_text_en:
Shi Le's strategist Zhang Bin said: "Wang Jun appears to be a subject of the Jin dynasty, but in reality, he wants to become emperor himself. General, your reputation is renowned throughout the realm. Wang Jun must surely wish to recruit you to help him achieve great deeds. Why not pretend to submit to him, bowing and declaring yourself his subject, to gain his trust?"
Shi Le clapped his hands joyfully and laughed, saying: "What a brilliant plan!" Then, Shi Le wrote a letter to Wang Jun.
summary_zh: 石勒的谋士张宾建议他假意向王浚称臣以取得信任，石勒采纳此计并写信给王浚。

page_text_ocr_zh:
石勒在信中是这样说的：
“我本来是个普通百姓，遇到饥荒，只好起兵造反，也只是为了保住性命。您出身于名门望族，天下人都尊敬您。现在天下大乱，您不当皇帝，还有谁能当皇帝？我现在四处征战，就是为您驱除那些乱臣贼子，助您早日登上皇位！”，
page_text_en:
Shi Le said in his letter: 
"I was originally an ordinary commoner. When famine struck, I had no choice but to rebel, only to preserve my life. You come from a distinguished family, and everyone under heaven respects you. Now that the world is in chaos, if you don't become emperor, who else could? I am now fighting everywhere, driving away those traitorous ministers and rebels, to help you ascend the imperial throne as soon as possible!"
summary_zh: 本页展示了石勒写给王浚的信件内容，信中他假意称臣，夸赞王浚出身高贵，称天下大乱应由其称帝，并表示自己征战是为了辅佐王浚登基，以此骗取信任。

page_text_ocr_zh:
石勒派出他最信任的官员王子春，带着信和许多珍宝，来到了幽州。
幽州太守王浚收到了石勒的信，又惊又喜，心里还有点不相信。他问王子春："石公是当今天下的英雄，为什么要向我俯首称臣？这不可信呀！"
page_text_en:
Shi Le sent his most trusted official, Wang Zichun, with a letter and many precious treasures to Youzhou.
Youzhou's governor, Wang Jun, received Shi Le's letter and was both surprised and delighted, yet still somewhat doubtful. He asked Wang Zichun: "Shi Gong is the hero of today's world. Why would he bow to me and call himself my subject? This cannot be true!"
summary_zh: 石勒派使者王子春携信与珍宝前往幽州，幽州太守王浚收到信后又惊又喜，但心存疑虑，质问使者为何石勒要向他称臣。

page_text_ocr_zh:
王子春说："我们石将军是文武全才，手下兵强马壮，确实如您所说，非同凡响。但您镇守一方，威名远扬，人人钦佩，谁敢不对您跪拜称臣呢？石将军和您相比，就如同月亮和太阳、江河和大海，我们诚心诚意归附您。"
这一番吹捧，听得王浚心花怒放。于是他派了使者，跟着王子春一起去襄国看一看。
page_text_en:
Wang Zichun said: "Our General Shi is a man of both literary and martial talent, with a strong and powerful army. Indeed, as you said, he is extraordinary. But you, who govern a region, are renowned and admired by all. Who dares not kneel and pay homage to you? Compared to you, General Shi is like the moon to the sun, or rivers to the sea. We sincerely wish to submit to you."
This flattery made Wang Jun overjoyed. So he sent an envoy to accompany Wang Zichun to visit Xiangguo.
summary_zh: 王子春向王浚献上奉承之词，称石勒愿归附于他，王浚听后大喜，随即派使者随王子春前往襄国考察。

page_text_ocr_zh:
全部收起来！
听说王浚的使者要来，石勒赶紧下令：
十六岁以上、四十岁以下的青壮年士兵，带上
骠肥体壮的战马，都躲到山里练兵去；打磨得锋
利雪亮的兵器，全部收起来；结结实实的盔甲盾
牌，都换成以前的破烂货；府里面的精美家具和
摆设都收起来，摆上又糙又破的旧家具。
page_text_en:
Everything, put it away!
Hearing that Wang Jun's envoy was coming, Shi Le hurriedly gave orders:
All able-bodied soldiers aged sixteen to forty, along with their strong warhorses, were to hide in the mountains for training; sharpened and gleaming weapons were to be put away; sturdy armor and shields were to be replaced with old, broken ones; all fine furniture and decorations in the mansion were to be hidden, replaced with rough, worn-out old furnishings.
summary_zh: 石勒得知王浚使者即将到来，立即下令伪装穷困：让士兵和战马躲入山中，收起精良兵器和盔甲，换上破旧装备，并将府中精美家具换成破烂旧物，以示自己实力薄弱，骗取王浚信任。

page_text_ocr_zh: 王浚的使者来到襄国，惊讶得下巴都快掉下来了。看守襄国城门的，不是十来岁的娃娃兵，就是五六十岁的老头。去兵营巡视，只见营帐破破烂烂；战马老的老，瘸的瘸；库房里空空荡荡，一粒存粮、一件兵器也没有。再来到石勒的府里一瞧，完好的家具没几件，更别提金银玉器和宝石摆件了，影子都没见着。
page_text_en: Wang Jun's envoy arrived in Xiangguo and was so astonished that his jaw nearly dropped. The guards at the city gate were not boys of ten or so, but men in their fifties or sixties. When he inspected the barracks, he saw only tattered tents; the horses were old and lame; the armory was empty, with not a single grain of stored food or weapon. When he went to Shi Le's residence, he saw only a few intact pieces of furniture, and not even a trace of gold, silver, jade, or gemstone ornaments.
summary_zh: 王浚的使者来到襄国，看到城门守卫年老、兵营破败、粮草兵器空无、府邸简陋，误以为石勒势力衰弱，完全被其伪装所迷惑。

page_text_ocr_zh: 使者把王浚的回信交给石勒，石勒像接圣旨一样，先向幽州的方向叩拜行礼，然后才洗净双手接过了信。王浚赠给石勒一柄拂尘，石勒根本不敢拿，而是叫人小心翼翼地放到架子上。
page_text_en: The envoy handed Wang Jun's reply to Shi Le. Shi Le, as if receiving an imperial edict, first knelt and bowed toward Youzhou, then washed his hands before taking the letter. Wang Jun gifted Shi Le a whisk, but Shi Le dared not touch it himself; instead, he had someone carefully place it on a stand.
summary_zh: 使者将王浚的回信和赠礼带给石勒，石勒对回信极为恭敬，对王浚所赠拂尘也倍加珍视，命人小心安放，表现出对王浚的极度敬畏与臣服姿态。

page_text_ocr_zh: 晚上，使者来见石勒，竟然看到他正在对着拂尘行礼。见使者来了，石勒不好意思地说：‘我虽然没有见过王公，但是见到王公赐的东西，就像见到他本人一样，所以早上和晚上都要行礼参拜。’
page_text_en: At night, the envoy came to see Shi Le, and was surprised to see him bowing to a whisk. When the envoy arrived, Shi Le said awkwardly, 'Although I have never met Lord Wang, seeing the things he has bestowed is like seeing him in person. Therefore, I bow to him both morning and evening.'
summary_zh: 使者夜访石勒，发现他正对着王浚所赠的拂尘行礼，石勒解释称这是对王浚的敬重，以此进一步伪装臣服姿态。

page_text_ocr_zh:
使者回到幽州，向王浚报告说："石勒手下都是些老弱残兵，没什么实力。他对您也是真心佩服，毕恭毕敬，您完全可以相信他。"
于是，王浚和石勒约定：明年三月中旬，石勒亲自到幽州城献礼，尊奉王浚为帝。
page_text_en:
The envoy returned to Youzhou and reported to Wang Jun: "Shi Le's troops are all old and weak soldiers, with no real strength. He truly admires you and is completely respectful. You can fully trust him."
Thus, Wang Jun and Shi Le agreed: in mid-March next year, Shi Le would personally go to Youzhou City to present gifts and proclaim Wang Jun as emperor.
summary_zh: 使者返回幽州，向王浚报告石勒势力虚弱、态度恭敬，王浚因此相信石勒，并与之约定次年三月中旬石勒亲自赴幽州献礼、尊奉王浚为帝。

page_text_ocr_zh:
到了第二年的三月，石勒亲自率领精兵，日夜赶路，悄悄地向幽州出发了。
王浚手下的将领们觉得石勒不可信，请求说："石勒贪得无厌，不讲信用。他说前来献礼，其中必有阴谋诡计，属下请求出兵拦住他。"
page_text_en:
In the third month of the following year, Shi Le personally led his elite troops, traveling day and night, secretly heading toward Youzhou.
Wang Jun's generals found Shi Le untrustworthy and pleaded: "Shi Le is greedy and dishonest. He claims to come to present gifts, but there must be a hidden plot. We request to send troops to intercept him."
summary_zh: 石勒率领精兵秘密前往幽州，王浚的将领们怀疑其诚意，请求出兵拦截。

page_text_ocr_zh: 可是，王浚还没听完手下的话，就大怒道："石勒真心诚意地投靠我，怎么会是阴谋诡计？如果我们出兵去拦他，世人不是会指责我王浚背信弃义吗？" 到了献礼这一天，王浚早早地就摆好了宴席，准备了美酒佳肴，等待石勒到来。
page_text_en: However, before Wang Jun could finish listening to his subordinate's words, he became furious and said, "If Shi Le sincerely submits to me, how could this be a plot? If we send troops to intercept him, wouldn't the world accuse me, Wang Jun, of breaking my word and being untrustworthy?" On the day of the tribute, Wang Jun had already set up a feast, prepared fine wine and delicacies, and waited for Shi Le to arrive.
summary_zh: 王浚拒绝了部下拦截石勒的建议，认为石勒是真心归附，于是准备宴席等待石勒前来献礼。

page_text_ocr_zh: 清晨，幽州城外黑压压的一大片，原来是石勒的士兵赶来了几千头牛羊。石勒骑着马来到城门下，对守门的士兵大声喊道："我给你们王将军献礼来了，快开门！"王浚得到报告后，连忙下令敞开城门，迎接贵宾。
page_text_en: In the morning, a vast, dark crowd appeared outside Youzhou City — it was Shi Le's soldiers driving thousands of cattle and sheep. Shi Le rode his horse to the city gate and shouted loudly to the guards: "I've come to present a gift to General Wang, open the gate quickly!" Upon receiving the report, Wang Jun immediately ordered the gates to be opened to welcome the honored guest.
summary_zh: 石勒率领士兵赶着大量牛羊抵达幽州城外，声称前来献礼，王浚听闻后下令打开城门迎接。

page_text_ocr_zh:
城门一开，几千头牛羊被石勒的士兵赶着涌进了城，一下子把街道堵得严严实实的。
王浚感到情况不妙，害怕起来，慌忙命令部队赶快出击。可是，牛羊堵满街道，士兵们怎么冲得出去呢？
就这样，石勒的大军畅通无阻地进了幽州城，大肆抢掠，很快，王浚也被抓住了。
page_text_en:
The city gate opened, and thousands of cattle and sheep, driven by Shi Le's soldiers, surged into the city, instantly blocking the streets completely.
Wang Jun sensed something was wrong and became frightened, hastily ordering his troops to attack. But with cattle and sheep filling the streets, how could the soldiers possibly break through?
In this way, Shi Le's army entered Youzhou City unimpeded, looting wildly, and soon, Wang Jun was captured as well.
summary_zh: 石勒的军队以牛羊为掩护，趁城门打开时涌入幽州城，堵塞街道，使王浚的军队无法出击，最终石勒大军顺利进城并俘虏了王浚。

page_text_ocr_zh: 石勒坐在王浚的席位上，讥讽地对他说："王将军，现在您可以接受我的献礼了。" 此时，王浚后悔也来不及了。 石勒先假意向王浚俯首称臣，用花言巧语骗得了王浚的信任，最后不费一兵一卒就攻下了幽州城。 这种为了擒获敌人，先故意示弱、退让，让敌人得意骄傲的计策，就叫"欲擒故纵"。
page_text_en: Shi Le sat on Wang Jun's seat and sarcastically said to him: "General Wang, you may now accept my tribute." At this point, Wang Jun regretted it too late. Shi Le had first pretended to submit to Wang Jun, deceived him with sweet words, gained his trust, and finally captured Youzhou City without losing a single soldier. This strategy, of deliberately showing weakness and retreating to make the enemy overconfident, is called 'Yù Qín Gù Zòng' (Letting the enemy become overconfident in order to capture him).
summary_zh: 石勒攻占幽州后，坐在王浚的席位上讥讽他，揭示了自己通过伪装臣服、骗取信任的计策成功俘虏王浚，点明此计为“欲擒故纵”。
